title: feat(nsparin): nspar x-probe own-lock-in exist-opposite: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Own-lock-in on the parallel-opposite seed {0:+e1,(1,0,0):-e1} x-probes, where A is itself a seed site. Refutes the naive reading of #7150: opposite seed letters are NOT sufficient for reverse - L(A)=-e1 has no +e1 partner in S^+(B)={+e2,+e3}, so reverse fails while face holds. The necessary-and-sufficient condition is -L(A) in S^+(B), not opposite seed letters per se.
